content:
maria.g: Hi team — I got my March pay today and net is ~€1,200 less than expected. I was paid my bonus but the payslip shows both US federal withholding and Irish PAYE taken out. I live/worked in Dublin since Jan 15. Any idea why both withholdings happened?
sarah.p: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the payslip or screenshot (redact account numbers)?
maria.g: pasted snippet below (redacted)
```
Gross bonus: EUR 8,000
Bonus taxed (US FED): 30% = EUR 2,400
PAYE (Ireland): 20% = EUR 1,600
Net bonus on slip: EUR 4,000
Total net pay shown: EUR 3,450
```
leo.payroll: thanks — that looks like the payroll engine applied the bonus to the employee record still flagged as US tax resident for payroll run 2026-03.
leo.payroll: @maria.g can you confirm your residency start date in Ireland and whether you submitted the change of tax residence form?
maria.g: I filed the relocation form with People Ops on Jan 10 and submitted my Irish PPS number on Jan 14. I have the confirmation email from People Ops.
alex.tax: quick note — tax treaty usually prevents double taxation but it depends on how payroll classified residency mid-pay period. If payroll cutover didn't occur before the bonus payroll cutoff, system might have calc'd US withholding then also applied PAYE as local payroll run.
sarah.p: leo — can you check payroll run id and whether the US withholding flag was cleared before the bonus run? Also please escalate if this needs an off-cycle fix.
leo.payroll: opening ticket now — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-5238 (created) — putting high priority. payroll-bot: Ticket PR-5238 created by leo.payroll: "Double withholding on EUR bonus for employee maria.g" — status: Open.
leo.payroll: maria — can you DM me the payslip PDF and the relocation confirmation email? I'll attach to the ticket.
maria.g: sent DM with attachments.
leo.payroll: FYI — initial root cause looks like two employer records overlapped: US payroll record still had the bonus mapped, and Irish pay run also processed the bonus (we run dual-country reconciliation for first month after relocation but this specific bonus was outside the automated dedupe).
leo.payroll: We'll issue an off-cycle corrective payment to undo the duplicate withholding and apply credit for the PAYE/federal as appropriate. Expect follow-up today with amounts.
sarah.p: we should also confirm if this affects year-end reporting (W-2 / Irish P60). Alex — any notes for accounting?
alex.tax: yes — if employee was Irish tax resident at time of employment duties, we can request a credit on US side and ensure local P60 reflects correct taxable income. We'll coordinate with tax advisor and payroll to avoid W-2 duplication.
leo.payroll: payroll-bot: PR-5238 update: investigation complete — duplicate bonus found in runs 2026-03-BONUS-US and 2026-03-BONUS-EU. Remediation: off-cycle payment scheduled for 2026-03-31, amount EUR 2,150 net. Retro tax adjustments to follow in April run.
maria.g: thank you — appreciate the quick response. Do I need to take any action for tax returns?
alex.tax: Hold for now — we'll send a short note if we need your signature for tax forms. Likely we handle via payroll corrections and provide corrected payslips and a summary letter for your records.
sarah.p: tagging @people-ops for records — we'll update relocation checklist to add a pre-payroll bonus cutover check to avoid this in future. :memo:
leo.payroll: closing loop here — will post final confirmation once off-cycle payment clears and adjusted payslip is uploaded.
payroll-bot: PR-5238 status changed to In Progress by leo.payroll at 1746010300.
leo.payroll: final note — expect corrected payslip + doc bundle in Self-Service by EOD 2026-03-31. If anything else pops up, ping me. :thumbsup:
